name: Ran Bloodtooth's Skull
summary: In Ashenvale, Ran Bloodtooth's Skull bears proof that a corrupted furbolg chieftain has fallen. The night elves of Astranaar receive it as a sign that a fierce threat to their woodland realm has ended.

sections.title: A Trophy of Ashenvale's Defense
sections.body: The furbolgs of Ashenvale have fallen into murderous madness under demonic taint and wilderness corruption. Ran Bloodtooth led one of the fiercest tribes. His skull gives the night elf Sentinels proof that he has fallen and his hold over the local furbolgs is broken, bringing some respite to Astranaar.

sections.title: Honoring the Fallen
sections.body: Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner receives Ran Bloodtooth's Skull in Astranaar, where it marks the end of an investigation begun by the fallen scout Teronis. Dartol's Rod, rebuilt after Teronis set out to find it, is displayed beside the skull. Together they honor those who fought to preserve the sacred forest.

faq.answer: Ran Bloodtooth led a corrupted furbolg tribe in Ashenvale, and the night elf Sentinels counted him among the fiercest threats in the region.

faq.q: Why do the Sentinels want his skull?
aliases: why do i need the skull
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner receives the skull in Astranaar as proof that Ran Bloodtooth has fallen. It is placed beside Dartol's Rod to remember those lost defending Ashenvale.

Teronis was Raene Wolfrunner's longtime friend and an ally of the Sentinels in Ashenvale. He sought a gem for a rod made by the dead wizard Dartol, hoping it would slow the furbolg attacks, but murlocs slew him at Lake Falathim. Raene Wolfrunner and visiting adventurers took up his task.

angles.text: For night elves, the skull marks a somber victory and honors Teronis's unfinished task. It also recalls how deeply demonic corruption has ravaged their former furbolg allies.
Delivering the grim trophy shows the mettle of Alliance champions defending Ashenvale's fragile borders beside the Sentinels.
